newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: TELECOMMS PRIVATISATION CONFERENCE IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: TELECOMMS PRIVATISATION CONFERENCE IN APRIL.

text.p: Lithuania's European Affairs Ministry said on Friday that it was inviting several international investment banks to participate in a conference next month on the privatisation of Lithuanian Telecomm.
The ministry said in a statement that Merrill Lynch, Nomura International, JP Morgan, Banque Pariba, and Dresdner Bank would be invited to the conference, to be held on April 18 to 19 in Vilnius.
Specialists from central European states where telecomms have already been privatised, including the Czech Republic, Poland, Hungary, Latvia and Estonia will also attend the conference.
Lithuanian Telecomm is one of several key state assets which the current government plans to sell by international bids.

Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius told Reuters on Thursday that the government would not back down on its privatisation drive in the face of a growing chorus of protest from public sector employees, who fear the loss of their job security.
